params.caption: 🎮 Candy Crush throws an Xbox 25th birthday party with Halo, Fallout and Doom Candy Crush Saga, owned by Xbox through King, has launched a "Game On" season for the Xbox 25th anniversary. A pin-collection event brings in items and elements from Halo, Fallout, Sea of Thieves, Forza, Doom, Banjo-Kazooie, Crash Bandicoot and Spyro, along with remixed versions of famous music from those series. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 01:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @Xbox 🍬 React if you'd play it · 💬 Which franchise crossover would you collect first? #CandyCrush #Xbox25 #Halo #GamingNews
